**Position:**
Brand Marketing Manager

**Reports to:**
Marketing Director

**Location:**
Head Office, Shepherd’s Bush, London. 4 days in the office, Fridays from home

**Contract:**
Full-time, fixed-term maternity cover for 12 months

**Role description**

We are looking for a creative, hands-on Brand Marketing Manager to join us on a 12-month maternity cover contract, owning channel planning and execution across all WYSE London brand marketing channels, including social media, creators, affiliates, community and PR.

This is an exciting opportunity to join the brand as we develop our marketing strategy and take WYSE London into its next stage of growth.

The role has a strong emphasis on social media management and content, including elevating our channels, testing new content and owning our ambassador and community programmes. It is a hands-on role, suited to a creative thinker who is not afraid to think outside the box.

Your ability to work closely with the Marketing Director and coordinate across departments, will be essential to the role.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Campaign planning & delivery**

• Channel planning across social media, creators, affiliates, PR and partnerships

• Managing the marketing calendar in-line with top-line messaging, product launches and key trading moments

**2. Social media & content**

• Managing all organic social channels, including content planning, posting and community management

• Growing audience and engagement across all channels

• Planning and briefing founder-led content

• Writing clear social content briefs for the in-house creative team, creators, photographers and freelancers

• Producing shoot plans, shot lists and content schedules to support social content production

• Supporting performance marketing channel content needs, working with the Marketing Director and performance marketing team to brief and deliver creative assets for paid social and other performance channels

• Ensuring all content follows the WYSE London visual and written tone of voice

**3. Ambassadors, creators, affiliates & community**

• Managing the ambassador programme across current ambassadors and new recruits

• Managing creator relationships, including gifting and paid partnerships

• Managing the affiliate programme and partners

• Growing and managing the WYSE London community, online and through events

**4. PR, partnerships & collaborations**

• Managing the PR agency, including briefing on launches, campaigns and key brand stories

• Identifying and suggesting brand partnerships and collaborations, drawing on a strong awareness of the WYSE London customer

**5. Brand reporting & stakeholder management**

• Reporting on brand performance, including social growth, engagement, creator and affiliate performance and PR coverage

• Communicating results to senior stakeholders

**Knowledge and skills**

• Previous brand marketing or social media experience is essential, ideally 6+ years in fashion, lifestyle or e-commerce

• Proven experience growing social channels and creating content

• Experience managing creators, ambassadors or affiliate programmes

• Experience managing a PR agency

• Creative, with the confidence to think outside the box

• Forward-thinking about the use of AI tools to enhance creativity, scale content and speed up delivery, while maintaining brand quality and tone of voice

• Strong organisational and project management skills

• Commercially minded and able to report on performance

• Able to work under pressure, to tight deadlines, and to show initiative

• Collaborative, with strong interpersonal and team skills

• Resilient and adaptable

**About WYSE London**

WYSE London is a UK online womenswear brand founded by Marielle Wyse, by women for women. The brand is for women with a joie de vivre, whatever their age or shape, offering elevated clothing that is unexpected and fun.

**How to apply**

Please email your CV and a covering letter to careers@wyselondon.com, with links to campaigns or social content you've delivered. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

**About Strava**
Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today.
  
  
Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward.
  
  
**About this role:**
We’re looking for a Campaign Operations Manager to join Strava for Business on a 12-month maternity cover contract, owning the delivery of sponsored campaigns across EMEA. You’ll be accountable for every campaign you run from signed contract to partner recap: multi-format, multi-stakeholder, and on time.
  
  
You’ll work with Account Managers as your commercial counterpart, and lead the delivery work with Copywriting, Localisation and external contractors where necessary. When something is at risk, you decide what to do about it and bring people along, rather than waiting to be told.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Own delivery end to end: Take the signed contract and own the campaign through launch, live and wrap-up across every format in the deal, including challenges and additional promotion. You’re the single point of accountability for scope, timeline and quality.
* Plan and run the build: Turn the contract into a delivery plan. Set up campaigns in our internal tools, brief copy, creative and localisation, and manage contractors and internal teams to deadlines.
* Quality gate: Run pre-launch QA on copy, assets and targeting against the contract. Nothing goes live that you haven’t signed off.
* Manage performance in flight: Monitor live delivery, spot risks early, and make or recommend the call: optimise, reallocate or escalate. Take the partner-facing recommendation to AMs rather than just flagging a problem.
* Close the loop with Account Managers: Close the loop with Account Managers: Support renewal conversations with effective and convincing activation recaps.
* Manage and coach external contractors: Work with external contractors to enable efficient delivery across timezones.
* Make the machine better: Fix the process, templates and documentation as you go. You’ll be working in a function that’s still being shaped, so you have room to change how we deliver.

**What you’ll bring to the team:**

* 4–6 years running multi-channel or multi-format campaigns end to end, in sponsorship, partnerships, media, agency or platform environments.
* Track record of owning delivery across multiple concurrent campaigns, partners and stakeholders, and hitting dates.
* Strong judgement under pressure. You know when to fix it, when to escalate and when to push back.
* Confident partner-facing communicator, comfortable presenting results and managing expectations.
* Exceptional attention to detail without losing sight of the outcome.
* Comfortable with processes still evolving, and wants to improve them.

****Why Join Us?****
Movement brings us together. At Strava, we’re building the world’s largest community of active people, helping them stay motivated and achieve their goals.
  
  
Our global team is passionate about making movement fun, meaningful, and accessible to everyone. Whether you’re shaping the technology, growing our community, or driving innovation, your work at Strava makes an impact.
  
  
When you join Strava, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a movement. If you’re ready to bring your energy, ideas, and drive, let’s build something incredible together.
  
  
Strava builds software that makes the best part of our athletes’ days even better. Just as we’re deeply committed to unlocking their potential, we’re dedicated to providing a world-class, inclusive workplace where our employees can grow and thrive, too. We’re backed by Sequoia Capital, TCV, Madrone Partners and Jackson Square Ventures, and we’re expanding in order to exceed the needs of our growing community of global athletes. Our culture reflects our community. We are continuously striving to hire and engage teammates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives because we know we are a stronger team together.

City St George’s, University of London is the University of business, practice and the professions and brings together the expertise and excellence of City, University of London and St George’s, University of London into one institution. The combined university is now one of the largest higher education destinations for London students, combining a breadth of disciplines across health, business, policy, law, creativity, communications, science and technology. Our students are at the heart of everything that we do, and we are committed to supporting them to pursue their career and personal ambitions.

Our research is engaged, at the frontier of practice and has a positive impact on the world around us.

**Background**

The External Communications and Media Officer supports the delivery of high-quality external communications and media activity that enhances City St George’s reputation, profile and visibility across external audiences.

The role is part of the External Relations directorate, which positions City St George’s as a leading university for business, practice and the professions, aligned to Vision & Strategy 2035. Bringing together marketing, communications, recruitment and admissions, the Directorate shapes a clear and compelling identity for the merged institution and drives growth in student recruitment, reputation and global reach.

Alongside targeted student recruitment, conversion and international expansion, External Relations amplifies the University’s research strengths, real world impact and contribution to society strengthening brand equity and deepening trust with partners, policymakers and the public.

Through integrated marketing, strategic communications and high performing recruitment and admissions activity, the Directorate enhances City St George’s external profile, builds stakeholder confidence and ensures the University is recognised as a first-choice destination for students and a valued civic institution in a competitive global landscape.

**Responsibilities**

This role has a primary focus on institutional and corporate storytelling, supporting the identification, development and promotion of content with strong external news value aligned to agreed University priorities. The postholder proactively identifies and develops profile-raising stories in key areas including student experience, education, employability, graduate outcomes and the University’s contribution to society.

Working closely with the External Communications Manager, and alongside Senior External Communications and Media Officers on defined stories and areas of activity, the postholder contributes to media relations activity, press office delivery and content development, helping ensure institutional stories are accurate, timely and effectively communicated.

The role supports the translation of University activity, research and expertise into clear, accessible content for external audiences and works collaboratively across External Relations to support effective amplification through appropriate channels.

**Person Specification**

The role requires strong written communication skills, curiosity, attention to detail and a proactive, flexible approach, using initiative and sound judgement to identify and deliver high impact stories that support agreed priorities. The ideal candidate will already be working at entry level in a relevant field, such as communications, PR or journalism and looking to progress their career to the next stage. A can-do attitude will be essential, alongside the ability to work unsupervised on stories. You will be as comfortable dealing with a first-year university student as with a senior university leader and able to build relationships with a diverse range of people, including external media (e.g. journalists, editors, producers) for stories with significant interest outside of the institution.

The role is subject to a probationary period of 12 months. Most people in the directorate work on a hybrid basis and it is expected that colleagues will spend the majority (at least 60%) of their usual working time on campus each week. Monday is typically a team day in our office in Clerkenwell.

**Closing date for applications** : 6th December 2026 at 11:59pm

**Interviews are scheduled to take place on:** dates TBC in mid-February

The selection process will involve a panel interview and a written exercise under timed conditions. Further details will be confirmed at the interview stage.

City St George’s offers a sector-leading salary, pension scheme and benefits including a comprehensive package of staff training and development.

City St George’s, University of London is committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion in all its activities, processes, and culture for our whole community, including staff, students and visitors.

We welcome applications regardless of age, caring responsibilities, disability, gender identity, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, pregnancy, race and ethnic origin, religion and belief, sex, sexual orientation and socio-economic background. City St George’s operates a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants.

**About Orchard**

Orchard is a SaaS security and compliance platform that helps organisations keep their Apple devices secure, up to date and audit-ready.

We continuously manage macOS updates, application patching and essential security controls, helping organisations overcome outdated software, security drift and inconsistent compliance without relying on manual intervention or a particular mobile device management platform.

Orchard isn't an MDM and doesn't aim to replace one. We complement existing tools by helping organisations achieve extremely high levels of patching and security compliance in areas where traditional MDM approaches struggle.

We're an early-stage company with a UK-based, fully remote team of around 10 people. We're now moving from product development and launch into our first phase of commercial growth.

That's where this role comes in.

**The role**

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Marketing Lead to take ownership of marketing at Orchard.

You'll join at an unusually interesting point in our journey. We have a differentiated product and a clear problem to solve, but we don't have a pre-written marketing playbook for you to execute.

There are ideas, expertise and support across the business, but you'll be responsible for turning those ingredients into a coherent marketing strategy and then making it happen.

The long-term ambition is for organisations using Macs around the world to know who Orchard is, understand what makes the platform different and believe in its ability to solve problems that other approaches can't.

This isn't a role where you'll develop a strategy and hand execution to a marketing team. We don't expect you to hire or manage a team at this stage. You'll be both the person shaping our marketing approach and the person doing much of the work.

You'll report directly to our Chief Revenue Officer and work particularly closely with our CTO and Engineering Lead to develop a deep understanding of Orchard, our market and upcoming product developments.

**What you'll be doing**

You'll take day-to-day ownership of Orchard's marketing activities and relationships. Your remit will be broad and will evolve as we learn what works.

**You'll be responsible for:**

* Developing Orchard's marketing plan and recommending where we should focus our time and budget.
* Working with the CRO to agree overall marketing strategy, priorities and spend.
* Building awareness of Orchard and communicating clearly why the platform is different.
* Helping establish credibility and confidence in Orchard amongst the Mac Admin community and the wider IT, security and compliance audience.
* Creating compelling content for our website, LinkedIn, email and other relevant channels.
* Planning, creating and running email campaigns using HubSpot Marketing Hub.
* Developing and improving our SEO activity and organic visibility.
* Identifying relevant events and opportunities, and taking responsibility for the marketing activity around them.
* Representing and promoting Orchard at events in the UK and overseas.
* Building relationships with relevant communities, podcasts, partners and other organisations that can help us reach our audience.
* Developing our presence within communities used by Mac administrators and other relevant technology professionals.
* Supporting our channel strategy by helping build awareness and engagement with partners and MSPs who may sell Orchard.
* Owning the marketing side of product launches, new features and important product updates.
* Working closely with technical colleagues to turn product capabilities into clear, credible and engaging market-facing messages.
* Coming up with new campaigns, events, partnerships and other ideas that can increase awareness and generate demand.
* Measuring the effectiveness of our activity and using what we learn to continually improve our approach.

Some of our initial focus will include podcasts and community engagement, events, LinkedIn and email, but we don't expect that list to remain static. Part of your job will be helping us discover which channels and activities work best for Orchard.

**What success looks like**

Ultimately, we want marketing to contribute to Orchard gaining customers.

There are important steps along the way, and we'll look at a combination of measures to understand whether we're making progress. These are likely to include:

* Free-trial sign-ups.
* Qualified interest and inbound enquiries.
* Website traffic and engagement.
* Growth in awareness and engagement within our target communities.
* Performance of campaigns, content and events.
* Contribution to sales pipeline and customer acquisition.
* Ultimately, growth in the number of organisations becoming paying Orchard customers.

We're realistic about how marketing works, particularly at an early-stage company. We don't expect you to arrive with a perfect plan on day one, and we don't expect every campaign or idea to succeed.

We do expect thoughtful experimentation: develop a hypothesis, try things, measure what happens, learn from it and put more energy into what works.

**Who we're looking for**

You'll already have meaningful marketing experience and be comfortable taking responsibility for both strategy and execution.

We're particularly interested in someone who:

Has strong B2B marketing experience and understands how marketing to organisations differs from consumer marketing.

Has previous marketing experience in SaaS, technology, cybersecurity or marketing to technical audiences

Has experience delivering a range of marketing activities rather than specialising exclusively in a single channel.

Can take a broad commercial objective and turn it into a practical marketing plan.

Is equally comfortable thinking about strategy and getting into the detail to execute it.

Can create strong written content and communicate technical or complex ideas clearly.

Has experience with campaigns, content, events and digital marketing

In this role, you will lead our content and engagement team, making sure our content, social media and client communications fulfil 7IM's commercial ambitions, deliver client value and meet our regulatory obligations. * Own relationships with external content and social suppliers, ensuring high-quality delivery and clear accountability.

  
Stakeholder Management:  

* Partner with the Senior Marketing Managers, Creative, Digital Growth & CRM, Sales, Investment and Compliance to deliver content that meets both commercial and regulatory needs.

* Commercially minded – connect content and engagement activity to business outcomes such as enquiries and leads.

* Detail-oriented – maintain high standards of quality and accuracy across a broad range of outputs.
* Well-organised – balance a range of priorities and deliver within agreed timelines.
* Communications – an excellent writer and editor, and a clear and engaging speaker.
* Stakeholder management – build trusted relationships at all levels, offering clear guidance and constructive feedback.
* Proactive and adaptable – takes initiative, is curious and open to change, and enjoys taking on new responsibilities.

**Knowledge**

* Experience leading content and/or social media activity, including managing and developing people.
* Good working knowledge of social media platforms (particularly LinkedIn and Meta), along with scheduling and analytics tools.
* Understanding of Consumer Duty and financial promotions requirements is desirable.
